title: Maintenance Workers, Machinery
description: Lubricate machinery, change parts, or perform other routine machinery maintenance.

tasks.text: Dismantle machines and remove parts for repair, using hand tools, chain falls, jacks, cranes, or hoists.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Disassembly requires hands-on tool use

dwas.name: Disassemble equipment for maintenance or repair.

tasks.text: Reassemble machines after the completion of repair or maintenance work.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Reassembly after repair requires hands-on fitting

dwas.name: Reassemble equipment after repair.

tasks.text: Record production, repair, and machine maintenance information.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Log maintenance and repair records from data

dwas.name: Maintain repair or maintenance records.

tasks.text: Lubricate or apply adhesives or other materials to machines, machine parts, or other equipment according to specified procedures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical lubrication task requiring hands and access

dwas.name: Lubricate equipment to allow proper functioning.

tasks.text: Install, replace, or change machine parts and attachments, according to production specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Replacing machine parts requires hands and tools

dwas.name: Install machine or equipment replacement parts.

tasks.text: Set up and operate machines, and adjust controls to regulate operations.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment adjustment for performance

dwas.name: Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.

tasks.text: Collaborate with other workers to repair or move machines, machine parts, or equipment.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Equipment diagnosis aided; hands-on fix is human

dwas.name: Confer with coworkers to resolve equipment problems.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Read work orders and specifications to determine machines and equipment requiring repair or maintenance.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Diagnosis from description aided, repair judgment human

dwas.name: Read work orders or descriptions of problems to determine repairs or modifications needed.

tasks.text: Inspect or test damaged machine parts, and mark defective areas or advise supervisors of repair needs.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Install/repair coordination is situated teamwork

dwas.name: Inspect mechanical equipment to locate damage, defects, or wear.
Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.
Communicate with coworkers to coordinate installations or repairs.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Start machines and observe mechanical operation to determine efficiency and to detect problems.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Detecting subtle equipment problems needs on-site sensory judgment

dwas.name: Observe equipment in operation to detect potential problems.

tasks.text: Transport machine parts, tools, equipment, and other material between work areas and storage, using cranes, hoists, or dollies.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Crane/hoist operation demands real-time physical control

dwas.name: Operate cranes, hoists, or other moving or lifting equipment.

tasks.text: Collect and discard worn machine parts and other refuse to maintain machinery and work areas.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of work areas

dwas.name: Clean work areas.

tasks.text: Inventory and requisition machine parts, equipment, and other supplies so that stock can be maintained and replenished.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

dwas.name: Maintain inventories of materials, equipment, or products.
Order materials, supplies, or equipment.

tasks.text: Remove hardened material from machines or machine parts, using abrasives, power and hand tools, jackhammers, sledgehammers, or other equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Cleaning parts for repair needs hands-on dexterity

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.

tasks.text: Replace, empty, or replenish machine and equipment containers such as gas tanks or boxes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical placement of containers for material flow

dwas.name: Position containers to receive materials or workpieces.

tasks.text: Clean machines and machine parts, using cleaning solvents, cloths, air guns, hoses, vacuums, or other equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Cleaning parts for repair needs hands-on dexterity

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.

tasks.text: Replace or repair metal, wood, leather, glass, or other lining in machines, or in equipment compartments or containers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual replacement of mechanical parts

dwas.name: Replace worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.
Repair worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Measure, mix, prepare, and test chemical solutions used to clean or repair machinery and equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Fluid testing requires lab equipment handling

dwas.name: Test fluids to identify contamination or other problems.
Prepare compounds or solutions to be used for repairs.

emerging_tasks.task: Troubleshoot electrical, hydraulic, or mechanical equipment and machines.
